verdict.rationale: Working Copy provides strong general git versioning: commit, amend, checkout old commits, undo unpushed commits, squash/delete commits, and even an AI 'Repository Agent' that can commit/pull/push via conversation. However, this is generic git functionality applied to any files, not a purpose-built system for tracking or rolling back 'automations' specifically, so it only partially satisfies an AI-native automation-versioning story.
